objective: Auditar exclusivamente el estado canonico real de Toast en EDARSAHUB BOS antes de construir cualquier adapter/executor. Confirmar estructura y presencia de Sistema_Tipos, Sistema_TiposVariantes, Sistema_VersionesSistemas, Sistema_Capacidades, Sistema_Sync_Catalogo, Sistema_Sync_Capacidades, Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos, Servidores_Conexiones, Servidores_ConexionEstado y Sync_Control_Ejecuciones. No leer secretos, no ejecutar conexiones externas, no DDL/DML, no Production, no crear ToastRobot ni tablas Toast_*.

queries.name: TOAST_R1_00_IDENTITY
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS database_user;

queries.name: TOAST_R1_01_REQUIRED_OBJECTS
queries.sql: SELECT name AS object_name, type_desc FROM sys.objects WHERE name IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos','Servidores_Conexiones','Servidores_ConexionEstado','Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion','Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion') ORDER BY name;

queries.name: TOAST_R1_02_SCHEMA_COLUMNS
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS type_name,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos','Servidores_Conexiones','Servidores_ConexionEstado','Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','Sistema_MapeoTablasVersion','Sistema_MapeoColumnasVersion') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id;

queries.name: TOAST_R1_03_SAFE_COUNTS
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Sistema_Tipos) AS sistema_tipos_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Sistema_VersionesSistemas) AS versiones_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Sistema_Capacidades) AS capacidades_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo) AS sync_catalogo_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones) AS conexiones_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Servidores_ConexionEstado) AS conexion_estado_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones) AS sync_runs_rows;

queries.name: TOAST_R1_04_TOAST_OBJECT_COLLISION_SCAN
queries.sql: SELECT name AS object_name,type_desc FROM sys.objects WHERE UPPER(name) LIKE '%TOAST%' ORDER BY name;

queries.name: TOAST_R1_05_TOAST_COLUMN_COLLISION_SCAN
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id WHERE UPPER(c.name) LIKE '%TOAST%' ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id;
